name: Fachwerk
description: Half-timbered walls: dark posts and rails framing plastered panels in chalk, ochre and rose, braced with struts, crosses and rails.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: @var(--ff); mask: @var(--ff); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: @p(@var(--f1), @var(--f2), @var(--f3), @var(--f3), @var(--f4)); clip-path: @p(@var(--f1), @var(--f2), @var(--f3), @var(--f3), @var(--f4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
